title: High load grow — params
description: Over N waiting requests, or KV cache over X %, for M minutes: add a replica on a free GPU (up to max_replicas). If no GPU is free the run records no_capacity and, when allowed, delegates to make_room_by_priority.

waiting_requests_above.title: N: waiting requests above
waiting_requests_above.description: metric_rollups_engine_1m.waiting_sessions_avg summed over the deployment. null disables this condition.

kv_cache_pct_above.title: X: KV cache usage above (%)
kv_cache_pct_above.description: metric_rollups_engine_1m.kv_cache_usage_pct_avg, max over instances. null disables this condition.

placement_strategy.title: Placement
placement_strategy.description: null = use the deployment's own strategy.

min_free_vram_bytes.title: Need free VRAM (bytes)
min_free_vram_bytes.description: null = scheduler estimate from the model version size and context.

make_room.title: Evict lower priority models if needed
make_room.description: Allow evicting idle lower-priority models (same semantics as make_room_by_priority) when no GPU is free.
